messages:
Maya (PM): Quick sync  decide GA-minimum observability surface. Customers keep asking: per-tenant cost, tracing for p99 tails, grouped error analytics. Can we agree scope?
Sam (Eng): +1. Concerned about tracing overhead at high QPS. We should do targeted hooks + sampling, not always-on.
Jordan (SRE): Targeted hooks + async export only. Add circuit-breaker to exporter. Also propose retention defaults: traces 14d, aggregates 90d.
Lee (Data): For cost: route-level % first. Per-tenant card possible but will be "estimated" until attribution pipeline is fully enabled. Expect ~5-10% variance initially.
Ruth (Customer Success): Sales needs a visible per-tenant cost card and top error groups to close deals. CSV export request too.
Maya (PM): Proposed GA-minimum:
- Ops dashboard: p50/p95/p99 for top routes
- Cost: route % + lightweight per-tenant card (estimated)
- Tracing: instrument top 5 slow endpoints with targeted spans + 100% on errors for those routes
- Error analytics: grouping by exception/type, top traces per group
- Perf gate: <=5% avg CPU increase on serving hosts
Sam (Eng): Implementation notes:
- Attach spans at router->model boundary
- Sampling: 1% global, 100% on error for selected endpoints
- Async export -> obs pipeline, circuit-breaker
Jordan (SRE): I'll define perf test and rollback thresholds.
Lee (Data): I'll ship cost-card backend + thin UI this sprint; include "estimated accuracy" tooltip linking docs.
Ruth (Customer Success): I'll curate top customer asks and write launch messaging.
Sam (Eng): Need infra quota for exporter topic  filing ticket now.
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: obs-instrumentation/spike -> staging at 2025-04-11T18:00Z :rocket:
Maya (PM): Owners set. Next sync Thursday 09:00. Thanks.
